create_MetadataRequest: create a MetadataRequest object to declare which metadata parameters each estimator method consumes
build_MetadataRouter: build a MetadataRouter object to define how metadata is routed from a meta-estimator to its sub-estimators
test_process_routing: test the process_routing function to route metadata parameters to requested estimator methods
review_get_routing_for_object: review the get_routing_for_object function to retrieve routing configuration from an estimator
run_MethodMapping: run a MethodMapping object to define caller-callee method pairs for metadata routing
